verdict.rationale: Kick documents its own MCP server and CLI. Through them an AI assistant can query transactions and generate reports from live Kick data using natural language, which is the core of grounding an agent's answer in the ledger. However, nothing documents affordability or cash-position answers (e.g. balance or runway/forecast reports exposed through MCP), and no public REST API spec was found (OpenAPI probes returned 404). missing for 10: documented affordability/cash-position or forecast query via MCP, published API reference, independent hands-on corroboration of agent answers grounded in live ledger data.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Your AI can query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping — all with your approval.
You can ask it to look things up, make changes, and run reports using natural language.
query your client data in plain language
pull transactions or financial statements with the Kick CLI
Kick works with any MCP-compatible assistant.
